title: Stir Fry Jamaican Jerk Potatoes
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry dish made with Jamaican jerk seasoning, potatoes, and a hint of quick cooking. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of quick cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
If using soy sauce, stir it in during the last minute of cooking.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
